blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Pamitinan Protected Landscape (PPL) in Montalban, Rizal, will reopen to the public on Sept. 19, according to thd Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) in Calabarzon said on Wednesday (September 16) . “We are pleased to inform the public that ecotourism activities in Pamitinan Protected Landscape (PPL) will resume on Sept. 19 following the completion of necessary cleanup operations, campsite maintenance, and safety assessment activities within the protected area,” the agency said in a public advisory posted on Facebook.
